title: Live transcript
summary: Watching the bytes of one channel while troubleshooting.

sections.title: Starting and stopping
paragraphs: The transcript is off until you press Start live transcript on a channel's page. It stops when you press Stop or the console disconnects. Only one viewer can watch a channel at a time; another is told that it is in use.

sections.title: What it shows
paragraphs: A bridge has two panes, A → B and B → A. A message channel has Source and Destinations. Source shows what the source sent (← Received) and how the engine answered it (→ Response). Destinations shows what the engine sent (→ Sent) and what the destination answered (← Reply), each tagged with its destination's name. Each pane keeps the newest 1,000 segments, up to 1 MiB, each with the time it was captured. Control characters are shown by name; Show hex adds the bytes. Freeze stops the display while capture goes on, and Unfreeze shows the newest. Clear empties the panes.

sections.title: Where it goes
paragraphs: A transcript lives only in memory and is sent only to this console. It is never stored, logged or sent anywhere else. Copy puts what is shown on the clipboard; that is your choice, and message bodies can hold patient information.
